g.text: Read delivery at this point: array peak 904 TB/s (40,353 macros x 22.4 GB/s) far exceeds the fabric, so B_R = min(array/3.37, L2-to-SM) = 19 TB/s. The deck's 17.7 was the 320 mm² array figure.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.9px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Everything on the x axis is an architectural assumption we sweep. Solid = overlapped bound, faint = serial bound. Shared-port service T = R/B_R + W/(beta B_R). HBM effective 6.4 TB/s from the measured B200 fit.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Model calculation, not a measurement. Tag-first: hit reads, miss fills (R = hD, W = (1-h)D). Parallel: every access reads the data array (R = D).

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The serial bound never breaks even for beta <= 1. Slack-implied beta re-expresses the 2026-09-20 reply (r = 0.8 -> 9.4, r = 0.6 -> 3.8 TB/s) in this model; it is not a deck value.
